summary: On the main deck, Tank registers that something has been altered — he 'sees what was changed.' His recognition is immediate and alarmed, and he declares the situation a deliberate ambush, shouting 'It's a trap!' to whoever is with him.

what_changes.before: unaware of what has been altered on the main deck
what_changes.after: understands what was changed and identifies it as a trap
what_changes.evidence: Tank sees what was changed. It's a trap!

event_hint.one_line: Tank realises the Matrix has been changed and that the crew has walked into a trap.
